sections.name: Verse 1
lines: [C]Tis the voice of [Dm]the [Bb]angels [C7]born [C]soft on the air

sections.name: Verse 2
lines: [F]On the banks of old Jordan, [C]here gazing I [Dm]stand,
[Gm/Bb]And earnestly [F]longing, I stretch forth my hand;
[F]Let me join [Am]that sweet music; [Gm]come, [Dm]take me away.

sections.name: Verse 3
lines: [F]Though dark are the waters [C]and rough is the wave,
[Gm/Bb]If Jesus [F]permit, the wild surges I'll brave;
[F]I must join [Am]in that chorus! [Gm]I'll [Dm]go! let me [F/C]go!
